supersession_reason: An outcome-free audit found that the 64-block, 12-cell Bonferroni map has only about 10.3% power for the registered multi-partition floor when paired-effect SD is 0.5. Preserve that blind surface as discovery, but require a deterministic selected-cell confirmation on 192 fresh blocks before any positive scripted-mechanism claim.

selection_rule.eligible: Both discovery point effects meet +0.25/+0.10 random-SD floors and all three topologies clear the registered progress floor.
selection_rule.ranking: Maximize the smaller effect surplus, then progress surplus, then prefer lower K and lower budget.
selection_rule.fallback: If no cell is eligible, maximize the smaller of effect and progress surplus using the same deterministic tie-breakers.

confirmation_design.error_control: Intersection-union test on fresh confirmation blocks; no alpha division across discovery cells or component nulls.
confirmation_design.search_progress_gate: Every topology mean must exceed the equal-budget iid-normal expected maximum plus 0.25 random SD.

execution_order: Finish and audit the original v6 phase map.
Finish and audit all eight v5 B=4096 CORAL mechanism blocks.
Run the unchanged registered 64-block extreme discovery map to completion without inspecting checkpoint outcomes.
Audit the discovery raw and generate the deterministic one-cell selection manifest.
Run all 192 fresh confirmation blocks without inspecting checkpoint outcomes.
Audit the confirmation and only then evaluate the positive scripted-mechanism gate.
Run natural-agent and Circle Packing validation only under their separately registered gates.
checkpoint_interpretation_lock: Before each registered run completes, inspect only completed_items and expected_items. Do not analyze or report topology outcomes from either checkpoint.
claim_boundary: The 64-block surface is discovery evidence; only a passing independent 192-block selected-cell confirmation can support the frozen scripted-mechanism claim. Natural-agent, CORAL-anchor, and real-task validity remain separate mandatory gates.
